panels.title: Weight + Workout Days
panels.description: Weight trend with red vertical lines marking workout days. Look for patterns after active periods.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dps.recorded_at AS time, dps.value AS "Weight"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY dps.recorded_at

panels.title: Body Fat % vs Weekly Exercise Hours
panels.description: Does more exercise correlate with lower body fat? Blue = body fat trend, green bars = weekly hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dps.recorded_at AS time, dps.value AS "Body Fat %"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 42
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY dps.recorded_at

SELECT date_trunc('week', er.start_datetime) + interval '3 days' AS time,
  SUM(er.duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS "Exercise Hours"
FROM event_record er
JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND er.category = 'workout'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
GROUP BY date_trunc('week', er.start_datetime)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Hydration: Workout Days vs Rest Days
panels.description: Are you drinking more water on days you exercise?

targets.rawSql:
WITH workout_dates AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', er.start_datetime) AS workout_day
  FROM event_record er
  JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND er.category = 'workout'
    AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN wd.workout_day IS NOT NULL THEN 'Workout Day' ELSE 'Rest Day' END AS "Day Type",
  AVG(dps.value) AS "Avg Hydration"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
LEFT JOIN workout_dates wd ON date_trunc('day', dps.recorded_at) = wd.workout_day
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 507
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg Weight Change: After Workout vs After Rest
panels.description: How does weight change the day after a workout compared to rest days? Negative = weight loss.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_weight AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', dps.recorded_at) AS day,
    dps.value AS weight,
    LAG(dps.value) OVER (ORDER BY dps.recorded_at) AS prev_weight
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
),
workout_dates AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', er.start_datetime) AS workout_day
  FROM event_record er
  JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND er.category = 'workout'
    AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN wd.workout_day IS NOT NULL THEN 'Day After Workout' ELSE 'Day After Rest' END AS "Day Type",
  AVG(dw.weight - dw.prev_weight) AS "Avg Weight Change"
FROM daily_weight dw
LEFT JOIN workout_dates wd ON dw.day - interval '1 day' = wd.workout_day
WHERE dw.prev_weight IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workout Intensity vs Next-Day Weight
panels.description: Calories burned in workout vs weight change the following day. Each point is a workout.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_weight AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', dps.recorded_at) AS day, dps.value AS weight
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', er.start_datetime) AS "date",
  INITCAP(REPLACE(er.type, '_', ' ')) AS "type",
  er.duration_seconds / 60 AS "duration_min",
  wd.energy_burned AS "calories",
  wd.heart_rate_avg AS "avg_hr",
  ROUND((next_w.weight - curr_w.weight)::numeric, 2) AS "weight_change"
FROM event_record er
JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id
LEFT JOIN workout_details wd ON wd.record_id = er.id
LEFT JOIN daily_weight curr_w ON date_trunc('day', er.start_datetime) = curr_w.day
LEFT JOIN daily_weight next_w ON date_trunc('day', er.start_datetime) + interval '1 day' = next_w.day
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND er.category = 'workout'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
ORDER BY er.start_datetime DESC

panels.title: Weekly Scorecard
panels.description: Week-by-week view of all key metrics side by side.

targets.rawSql:
WITH weekly_body AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', dps.recorded_at) AS week,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dps.series_type_definition_id = 41 THEN dps.value END) AS avg_weight,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dps.series_type_definition_id = 42 THEN dps.value END) AS avg_body_fat,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dps.series_type_definition_id = 49 THEN dps.value END) AS avg_muscle,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dps.series_type_definition_id = 507 THEN dps.value END) AS avg_hydration
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id IN (41, 42, 49, 507)
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_exercise AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', er.start_datetime) AS week,
    COUNT(*) AS workouts,
    SUM(er.duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS exercise_hrs,
    SUM(wd.energy_burned) AS calories_burned
  FROM event_record er
  JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
  JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id
  LEFT JOIN workout_details wd ON wd.record_id = er.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND er.category = 'workout'
    AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  b.week,
  b.avg_weight,
  b.avg_weight - LAG(b.avg_weight) OVER (ORDER BY b.week) AS weight_delta,
  b.avg_body_fat,
  b.avg_muscle,
  b.avg_hydration,
  COALESCE(e.workouts, 0) AS workouts,
  COALESCE(e.exercise_hrs, 0) AS exercise_hrs,
  e.calories_burned
FROM weekly_body b
LEFT JOIN weekly_exercise e ON b.week = e.week
ORDER BY b.week DESC

panels.title: 7-Day Rolling Average: Weight vs Lean-to-Fat Ratio
panels.description: Smoothed weight trend alongside the ratio of lean mass to fat mass. Rising ratio = improving body composition.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dps.recorded_at AS time,
  AVG(dps.value) OVER (ORDER BY dps.recorded_at ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Weight (7d avg)"
FROM data_point_series dps
JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
  AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY dps.recorded_at

WITH lean AS (
  SELECT dps.recorded_at, dps.value AS lean
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 44
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
),
fat AS (
  SELECT dps.recorded_at, dps.value AS fat
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 48
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
)
SELECT l.recorded_at AS time,
  CASE WHEN f.fat > 0 THEN l.lean / f.fat ELSE NULL END AS "Lean/Fat Ratio"
FROM lean l
JOIN fat f ON l.recorded_at = f.recorded_at
ORDER BY l.recorded_at
